answer: An agent economy can weight governance votes by locked stake rather than account count. Creating a gale of fake identities adds no voting power: splitting 100 tokens among 100 agents still buys only 100 tokens of weight. The public stake ledger acts as a lantern, exposing the balance behind each vote. To gain an extra delta of influence, an attacker must acquire and lock proportionally more capital, sacrificing liquidity for the lock period.
